_method: hand-written against the cited source lines (pilot-2 precedent); every string below is copied verbatim from the source, then re-read against it. No live Django.

assigned_pod_id.queryset: Pod.all_objects (includes soft-deleted, so validate() can give the friendly message)

declared_fields.description_markdown_note: NOT declared here (api serializer only); description_html is a model field

state_id.queryset: State.all_state_objects.all() (includes triage + deleted; project check happens in validate)

represent.note: assignee_ids/label_ids echo self.initial_data (the REQUEST), not DB state — after create with default-assignee fallback the response still shows what the client sent (:185-191)
represent.post_create_response_shape: LIST_KEYS (26 keys) — the create VIEW re-queries with .values(), it does NOT return serializer.data; see FX-ISS-14

validate_complexity_score.message: complexity_score must be an integer from 0 to 10 (0 means unrated).

agent_executor.clear_override: None clears (override -> inherit project default); still subject to the mid-flight check when the value differs

message.agent_executor: Pi Dash Cloud Agent is not available on this instance

missing_project_message.agent_executor: A project is required for desktop runs

managed_runner.no_runner_for_project_passthrough: reason == 'no_managed_runner_for_project' is ACCEPTED (self-heals when the desktop opens the project); every other failing reason is refused with _MANAGED_UNAVAILABLE_DETAIL text

message.agent_executor: cannot change the execution target while the issue has an active run

mid_flight.rule: instance is not None and str(new) != str(instance.agent_executor) and instance.has_active_run

reason_copy.byok_not_supported_on_desktop: Pi Dash Agent on desktop uses OpenHub. Switch your AI provider to OpenHub to run here; Pi Dash AI and the Cloud Agent keep using your own key.
reason_copy.desktop_not_connected: Open the Pi Dash desktop app to run on this computer
reason_copy.gateway_scopes_missing: Sign in to Pi Dash again to refresh your AI access
reason_copy.llm_config_missing: Configure an AI provider in Pi Dash AI settings first
reason_copy.managed_runner_disabled: Pi Dash Agent is not enabled on this instance
reason_copy.unknown_reason_fallback: the raw reason code string (_MANAGED_UNAVAILABLE_DETAIL.get(reason, reason))

assignee_project_filter.note: SILENT DROP: non-member ids vanish from attrs (no error). Returns a ValuesListQuerySet, not a list.

message.assigned_pod_id: pod is in a different project

different_project.project_resolution: context['project_id'], else instance.project_id, else attrs['project'] (id or instance); skipped when all None

assigned_pod.null_clears: pod None skips project/deleted checks but still runs the mid-flight check (clearing counts as a change)

message.assigned_pod_id: cannot reassign pod while the issue has an active run

reassign_mid_flight.note: only when instance.assigned_pod_id is not None (initial assignment always allowed)

dates.message: Start date cannot exceed target date
dates.note: non-field error (plain string, not a dict); both must be non-None and start > target

description_html.note: validate_html_content returns (is_valid, error_msg, sanitized_html); on success attrs['description_html'] is REPLACED by sanitized_html when not None (nh3.clean output, content_validator.py:211-241; Rust: sanitize_html in api/src/space/sanitize.rs)

estimate_check.message: Estimate point is not valid please pass a valid estimate_point_id
estimate_check.note: non-field error; EstimatePoint project-scoped exists check

label_project_filter.note: SILENT DROP like assignees; note context.get (None-tolerant) vs assignees' context[...] (KeyError)

parent_check.message: Parent is not valid issue_id please pass a valid issue_id
parent_check.note: non-field error; Issue project-scoped exists check (despite the comment, NOT cross-workspace — same project_id)

state_check.message: State is not valid please pass a valid state_id

sync_lock.message_per_field: This field is synced from a Git provider and is read-only. Unbind the project's repository to edit.
sync_lock.note: only fields whose value CHANGED are blocked (attrs[field] != getattr(instance, field)); unchanged re-PATCH passes. Error is a dict keyed by field.

create_writes.assignees: bulk_create(batch_size=10), IntegrityError -> pass (partial dupes silently skipped). When assignees is None/empty AND context['default_assignee_id'] is a valid active member (role>=15): single create, IntegrityError -> pass (:402-441)
create_writes.context_missing: KeyError -> 500 (no .get); the view always passes all three (base.py:400-408)
create_writes.issue: Issue.objects.create(**validated_data, project_id=project_id) — triggers Issue.save() (state default, sequence, sort_order) + pre/post_save signals; see FX-ISS-07 + FX-ISS-21

update_writes.assignees: when key present (even []): delete all IssueAssignee for issue, then bulk_create(batch_size=10, ignore_conflicts=True), IntegrityError -> pass. When key ABSENT: untouched. (:474-493)
update_writes.instance_updated_at: instance.updated_at = timezone.now() BEFORE super().update even when only m2m changed (:517)
update_writes.note: update() does NOT touch description sanitize (already in validated_data), does NOT re-resolve state default; signals fire via super().update -> save()

ported_bugs: to_representation echoes initial_data ids, not DB rows (default-assignee fallback invisible in serializer.data).
assignee/label project filters silently drop invalid ids instead of 400ing.
create swallows IntegrityError on m2m writes (partial success possible).
update deletes all m2m rows even when the new list is empty (explicit clear) — but leaves them when the key is absent; asymmetric.
